title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.26863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find

translated_title: 大语言模型在后训练过程中会记住自己产生的幻觉
translated_abstract: 推理领域已经塑造了前沿模型的后训练方案，即使这些模型是在数学和代码之外的领域进行训练和部署的。在本文中，我们研究了直接采用以推理为中心的训练方案（例如，在强化学习（RL）中使用基于结果的奖励、在推理链中注入“认知”行为如提出假设并从中回溯等）对知识任务的影响。我们假设这些决策虽然对推理有益，但在知识任务上训练时，会在无意中鼓励模型记住它们在长推理链中自己产生的幻觉。为了研究这一点，我们使用标准后训练方案训练模型，在强化学习过程中提取它们自我生成的幻觉，并在后续训练过程中跟踪这种记忆现象。我们在两个模型家族、两种架构共六个开源模型上的实验证实了我们的假设。我们发现
tldr: 该论文发现，采用以推理为中心的后训练方案（如基于结果的强化学习奖励和“认知”行为注入）会导致大语言模型在知识任务训练中记住自己在长推理链中产生的幻觉，且这一现象在多个开源模型上得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that adopting reasoning-centric post-training recipes (e.g., outcome-based RL rewards and injected "cognitive" behaviors) causes LLMs to memorize their own hallucinations generated in long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks, a finding confirmed across six open models from two families and two architectures.
